title.es: Acorazado de la Flota del Nether

generated.description: A large battleship built from obsidian and red wool, styled as a nether-themed warship with a long hull, a raised superstructure and a few stern and bow details. It stands about 129 blocks wide, 53 high and 73 deep, and contains an interior with chests, furnaces, a bookshelf, beds, an enchanting table and a record player. It is made of roughly 37,500 blocks, with most of the mass in obsidian and nether bricks.
